entry_state: Ordinary EPS requires allocating earnings under the actual participation rights before division and recalculating that allocation after assumed issuance. The capped-family ordering proof requires complete additive gross effects; a shared threshold bonus breaks those effects and leaves general selection unresolved despite correct conditional worlds. Contingent options additionally require an admitted similar option's assumed exercise. The participating-dividend tax example retains a signed residual across years, so its negative year-three adjustment reverses earlier allocation without becoming a cash dividend or a tax-loss asset.
exit_state: Consolidation follows a supported dated control assessment and separate group adjustments rather than ownership percentages alone. Acquisition goodwill, profit, cash translation and currency reserves have distinct owners and bridges. Loss of control removes the whole subsidiary and NCI, measures a retained interest separately and recycles only the parent's reserve. Equal final equity can conceal wrong intermediate goodwill, profit attribution or cash flow, so the next implementation account must preserve each legal book, dated snapshot, perimeter and currency dependency.

findings.judgment: ParticipatingTaxEPS/1 permits a signed post-dividend residual and returns neither a dividend nor a tax asset or journal. Hypothetical class tax effects can make allocated EPS earnings exceed reported profit without a journal to force equality. Shared benefits, losses, capped or changing rights and general nonadditive dilution remain outside this method.

The simple zero-goodwill disposal and subsequent acquisition example remain distinct. Eighty percent ownership is not itself a control conclusion. ControlAssessment and PerimeterVersion preserve unknown control alternatives, substantive rights, the relevant interval and exact dated books. The acquisition's goodwill 16, subsequent NCI 24, retained-control equity debit 3 and alternative disposal gains 18/23 are explained under their different transaction premises.

An unsold intragroup transfer eliminates AR/AP 100, internal revenue 100, cost of sales 60 and unrealized inventory profit 40, leaving group inventory 60. An external sale for 120 later realizes group profit 60. A supplied tax base 100 and recognized 25 percent difference can give DTA 10 while seller tax remains real. Functional-currency remeasurement is separated from presentation translation, including the cumulative transaction FX expense 5 and the separate translation OCI 11.

The joined foreign acquisition establishes business, control, currency and proportionate-NCI premises before calculating goodwill. The workforce is subsumed into goodwill, not used to invent a separate asset. Opening inventory is translated at the event rate before sale. Translation OCI 12.6 comprises net-asset gain 11 plus parent-only goodwill gain 1.6; allocating the entire amount 80/20 would misattribute the goodwill reserve.

Cash exchange effect 7 is reconciled separately from translation OCI 12.6. Both loss-of-control alternatives remove all subsidiary cash 156 and goodwill 20.8, yielding pre-recycling gain 23.4 and total gain 33.8 after the parent's reserve 10.4. NCI reserve 2.2 is derecognized without profit recycling. A retained interest 42.25 is not cash; its alternative produces net disposal cash flow -29.25. The equity bridge retains period NCI OCI despite zero closing NCI. Explicit counterexamples show why equal ending equity would miss wrong goodwill translation or recycling.

The move into implementation is motivated by the concrete error of recording removal of subsidiary cash as a parent payment. Legal-entity books, the group adjustment book, entity identifiers, functional currencies and exact snapshots are introduced before their dependencies. Tax, valuation, impairment, current authority and subsequent retained-interest classification remain separate required inputs.
